metadataRaw.title: How to Stop Muscle Loss in Your Legs (Ages 55+)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates the best exercises to reduce and reverse muscle loss in the legs caused by sarcopenia.

Sarcopenia is the gradual loss of muscle mass and strength due to aging, leading to balance issues and an increased risk of falls and injuries.

As we age, it's extremely important to do strengthening exercises to maintain muscle mass in our legs. 

These exercises will help by focusing on the main leg and hip muscles, and are gentle enough to do daily.

For best results, try all of the exercises and target any weak areas.

Link to resistance band: https://amzn.to/3C5R1JE

0:00 Intro
0:53 Wall Sits
